constellations.summary: High-speed Hydro off-field DPS and damage ramp buffer with Exquisite Throw dice.
Lingering Lifeline gains 1 additional charge (massively lowers ER needs and boosts overworld exploration).
Exquisite Throw fires an extra water arrow dealing 14% of Yelan's Max HP every 1.8s (improves Hydro application).
Increases all party members' Max HP by up to 40% based on enemies marked by Lifeline.
Converts next 5 Normal Attacks after Burst into Breakthrough Barbs dealing massive AoE Hydro DMG.
